resources.string: Shared app and widget settings. Changes take effect when you tap Apply.
Apply your changes before leaving, or keep the previous settings?
Excluded folders do not appear in the widget selection. Excluding a folder also excludes all its subfolders and contents.
Tags from the tags property and note text. An empty include list allows any tags. Exclusions take priority.
Excluded by folders: %1$d. Total before exclusions: %2$d.
No matches. Check excluded folders and tags, All selected tags, and Favorites only.
This is how a note will look with your theme, colors and text size. Text wraps and fills the available height. Transparent themes use a gray preview backdrop.
Automatic updates run approximately at the selected interval. Quiet hours pause automatic updates only; the widget button always works.
Optional: defaults to the selected folder name. Your notes folder must be the Obsidian vault root.
A path inside your notes folder, e.g. Daily/Personal. Empty means the root. Missing subfolders are created when a note is saved.
Initial note text. {{date}} is today in YYYY-MM-DD format, {{title}} is the title. Example: created: {{date}} inside YAML frontmatter.
The template is empty: new notes start with no text.

Notes from this calendar day in previous years across the entire selected folder. Tags, favorites and user folder exclusions do not apply. Service folders are skipped. File modification time is not treated as creation time; notes without a known date are skipped.
Could not read the catalog. Check folder access and tap Rescan files.
Wait for the catalog. If scanning failed, tap Rescan files.
Use a relative path without leading /, backslashes, . or ..
Could not apply settings. Check folder access. Previous settings are preserved.
